question:
Assertion (A): If the objective function of an LPP attains its maximum at two distinct corner points of the feasible region, there are infinitely many optimal solutions.

Reason (R): A linear function attains constant values along the straight line joining two points where its value is the same.
explanation:
If two corner points yield the same optimal value of the objective function, every point on the line segment joining them also produces the same value.

This occurs because the objective function is linear and remains constant along that segment.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
